qualification: Fresh canonical production processes with a separate signed injected diagnostic library. Five- and thirty-second captures use the original disk-only SOCKS replay, scripts, private profiles/caches, unfocused 1024x768 document viewport and scale 2. Main-thread API/method scopes read current-process instructions, including concurrent threads and observer overhead. Self subtracts only nested observed scopes; inclusive totals overlap and cannot be summed. The constructor-to-atexit process counter is diagnostic and differs from the exclusive-coalition acceptance backend. Caller addresses use their actual dladdr image, not dyld image zero. Script factory URLs/UTF16 lengths describe creation; compilation can be deferred until evaluation. No JavaScript getters, function names or author source text are inspected. System frameworks are identified by OS version, runtime image and checked Objective-C ABI; non-system native paths and probe hashes are pinned throughout. No unprofiled optimization, live-site or Brave acceptance credit.
